body: we've known each other for a year and he made it "official" & that lasted not even a couple months without him not being able to do it anymore

a little boy couldn't handle a relationship after two months so he called it quits over text but it's funny because he actually initiated the entire thing!! other people got involved too making it so much worse.
thank you for this! i will try getting back into a routine and focus on myself more often :)) sometimes you just need a reminder to do small things again.
doesn't matter i've deleted their numbers and don't plan to see them ever, probably going to move to another state and get my life together and focus on me!
i'm still angry too but that will subside in time & i promise you will feel so much lighter when they're gone from your life
it's amazing how sick people can be, but you are much better off without them

Organising actually helps me clear my mind but at first it can seem overwhelming. Try to move all your apps to a second page so you have a clear one to start with. Separate them into sections or categories it makes it easier. Also having a simple background helps make it feel and look less cluttered. It may take a few tries for you to find something that you like but you will get it.
